title: TCG:LGS-B2

objectives.text:
Put Forest Queen Diana into zone 5 with 4 +1 ATK and +1 DEF counters on her. Put a Prisoner's Cage into zone 2 and another one into zone 4.
If you have exactly 1 hero in play at the start of each round, remove a +1 ATK and a +1 DEF counter from Forest Queen Diana. If you KO her, you win.
